title: Session 13: Canvas and Web Storage in HTML5

questions.questionText: The <canvas> element is:
options: A drawing area for graphics drawn using JavaScript
questions.correctAnswer: A drawing area for graphics drawn using JavaScript
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) A drawing area for graphics drawn using JavaScript.

questions.questionText: The <canvas> element eliminates the need for:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Plug-ins for graphics.

questions.questionText: Canvas does not have drawing abilities of its own; drawing is done using:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) JavaScript.

questions.questionText: The method that returns the drawing context of a canvas is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) getContext().

questions.questionText: Which interface does the canvas element expose in the DOM?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) HTMLCanvasElement.

questions.questionText: Which attributes define the size of a canvas?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) width and height.

questions.questionText: Which method begins a new path for drawing?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) beginPath().

questions.questionText: moveTo(x, y) is used to:
options: Position the drawing cursor at a point
questions.correctAnswer: Position the drawing cursor at a point
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Position the drawing cursor at a point.

questions.questionText: lineTo(x, y) is used to:
options: Draw a line from the current position to the given point
questions.correctAnswer: Draw a line from the current position to the given point
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Draw a line from the current position to the given point.

questions.questionText: stroke() is used to:
options: Assign color to the line and display it
questions.correctAnswer: Assign color to the line and display it
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Assign color to the line and display it.

questions.questionText: The strokeStyle property sets:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) The color of the line.

questions.questionText: Which method creates a rectangle on canvas?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) rect().

questions.questionText: rect(18, 50, 200, 100) takes parameters in order:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) x, y, width, height.

questions.questionText: Which method draws a circle or arc?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) arc().

questions.questionText: fill() is used to:
options: Fill the current path with the fill style
questions.correctAnswer: Fill the current path with the fill style
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Fill the current path with the fill style.

questions.questionText: Which method draws an image on a canvas?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) drawImage().

questions.questionText: Which property sets the font for canvas text?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) font.

questions.questionText: Which method draws filled text on canvas?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) fillText().

questions.questionText: Which method draws outlined text on canvas?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) strokeText().

questions.questionText: Which property sets transparency of canvas drawings?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) globalAlpha.

questions.questionText: A globalAlpha value of 0 means:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Fully transparent.

questions.questionText: The jQuery function that combines mouseenter and mouseleave is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) hover().

questions.questionText: The jQuery toggle() event responds to:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Mouse clicks with multiple functions.

questions.questionText: The <embed> tag in HTML5 is a container for:
options: Interactive content or an external application
questions.correctAnswer: Interactive content or an external application
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Interactive content or an external application.

questions.questionText: The <eventsource> tag was introduced to:
options: Push external content to a page
questions.correctAnswer: Push external content to a page
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Push external content to a page.

questions.questionText: Traditionally, Web applications stored small data on the client using:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Cookies.

questions.questionText: Web storage is a specification of:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) W3C.

questions.questionText: Some browsers refer to Web storage as:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) DOM Storage.

questions.questionText: Web storage can store a maximum of about ______ per domain.
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) 5 MB.

questions.questionText: A cookie can store about:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) 4 KB.

questions.questionText: Cookies are sent with each:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) HTTP request.

questions.questionText: Web storage data is:
options: Stored only on the client side
questions.correctAnswer: Stored only on the client side
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Stored only on the client side.

questions.questionText: The two types of Web storage are:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Session storage and local storage.

questions.questionText: A property to check Web storage support is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) localStorage or sessionStorage on window.

questions.questionText: If Web storage is not supported, the property will be:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) undefined.

questions.questionText: Session storage data is:
options: Discarded when the tab or window is closed
questions.correctAnswer: Discarded when the tab or window is closed
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Discarded when the tab or window is closed.

questions.questionText: Each browser window has its own:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Session storage object.

questions.questionText: Session storage stores data as:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Named key/value pairs.

questions.questionText: Regardless of the data type, Web storage stores values internally as:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Strings.

questions.questionText: To convert stored data back to an integer, use:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) parseInt().

questions.questionText: Which method stores data in session storage?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) setItem().

questions.questionText: Which method removes one item from storage?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) removeItem().

questions.questionText: Which method clears all items from storage?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) clear().

questions.questionText: The length attribute of storage returns:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) The number of key/value pairs.

questions.questionText: Local storage data is:
options: Persistent and retained after the browser is closed
questions.correctAnswer: Persistent and retained after the browser is closed
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Persistent and retained after the browser is closed.

questions.questionText: Local storage is useful for:
options: Counting the number of visits to a page
questions.correctAnswer: Counting the number of visits to a page
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Counting the number of visits to a page.

questions.questionText: Local storage uses ______ methods as session storage.
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) The same.

questions.questionText: IndexedDB is:
options: An object store for client-side data
questions.correctAnswer: An object store for client-side data
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) An object store for client-side data.

questions.questionText: IndexedDB stores data as:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Objects in an object store.

questions.questionText: IndexedDB is implemented using the:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) window.indexedDB object.

questions.questionText: IndexedDB supports which two types of APIs?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Synchronous and asynchronous.

questions.questionText: The synchronous IndexedDB API can be used with:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Web Workers.

questions.questionText: IndexedDB enables Web applications to work:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Both online and offline.

questions.questionText: Browsers implement IndexedDB with vendor prefixes because:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) The specification was still evolving.

questions.questionText: An advantage of native apps is:
options: Better access to device features and performance
questions.correctAnswer: Better access to device features and performance
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Better access to device features and performance.
